cruxes.question: Does the cardioprotective effect of choline/lutein persist when controlling for the specific preparation method (e.g., fried vs. poached)?
Is the observed CVD risk in Western cohorts a function of egg consumption or a proxy for the 'Western dietary pattern' (processed meats/refined carbs)?

evidence_streams.label: Hartmann et al. 2023 Meta-analysis
evidence_streams.weakness: Relies on aggregate data that may mask heterogeneity in preparation methods and baseline diet quality.
supports: Does the cardioprotective effect of choline/lutein persist when controlling for the specific preparation method (e.g., fried vs. poached)?

evidence_streams.label: Western Cohort FFQ Studies (Harvard/NHANES)
evidence_streams.weakness: High reliance on self-reported dietary recall and significant residual confounding from co-consumed foods.
supports: Is the observed CVD risk in Western cohorts a function of egg consumption or a proxy for the 'Western dietary pattern' (processed meats/refined carbs)?

evidence_streams.label: Mechanistic LDL-C/Hyper-responder data
evidence_streams.weakness: Surrogate marker (LDL-C) does not always correlate linearly with hard CVD clinical endpoints.
supports: Does the cardioprotective effect of choline/lutein persist when controlling for the specific preparation method (e.g., fried vs. poached)?

correlated_pairs.shared_assumption: Reliance on identical Food Frequency Questionnaires (FFQs) and overlapping demographic populations.
correlated_pairs.implication: The apparent consensus in Western cohorts is an artifact of shared measurement error; the effective evidentiary weight is significantly lower than the sum of the studies.

calibrated_estimates.hypothesis: Moderate egg consumption (1/day) is cardioprotective in the general population.
calibrated_estimates.conditions: Assumes a background diet low in processed meats and refined sugars; range shifts lower if preparation involves high-heat frying in trans-fats.

settled: Dietary cholesterol intake has a highly variable impact on serum LDL-C levels across individuals.
performed_as_settled: Eggs are a monolithic dietary variable with a uniform effect on cardiovascular health regardless of preparation or dietary context.
